title: Fix: parallel generations failing with a connection error
notes:
- Fix: x4 to x9 generations (Seedream, GPT Image and the other engines) no longer fail with "connection dropped" when the upload is slow or busy: a slow upload was being cut off after 15 seconds. Images now upload a few at a time, slow uploads are allowed to finish, and a stalled one is retried - it was never billed
- Region edits: the Edits tab opens on the image you are editing (not on an older edit)
- Alt + wheel also zooms out (down to 30%), so a selection can reach the picture's borders
- An edit that comes back as an empty black area is retried and never pasted
- Cancel is honoured while a slot waits for its upload turn
- Seedream with a cutout: the car's exposure is matched to the scene before the render - a cutout rendered under dark studio light no longer stays a flat, dark car in a bright scene
- Seedream: no more glowing neon line or flames along the car's roof at high lighting creativity in dark scenes
